four FeCrAl alloys with a nominal composition of Fe-13Cr-4.5Al-1Nb-2Mo-xSi (x = 0, 0.5, 1, and 2 wt.%) were synthesized by arc-melting

synthesized by arc-melting pure Fe, Cr, Al, Nb, Mo and Si in an argon atmosphere using a vacuum electric arc furnace. And each ingot was repeatedly melted at least six times to ensure chemical homogeneity.
the 15 mm thick samples were firstly subjected to a normal hot-rolling (15 mm to 10 mm) at a temperature of 1100 °C followed by water quenching (WQ).
low-temperature hot-rolling (HR) (10 mm to 5 mm) at a temperature of 800 °C followed by WQ.
warm rolled (WR) at 300 °C (5 mm to 1.5 mm)

recrystallization annealed at different temperatures for 0.5 h. The recrystallization temperatures of Si0, Si0.5, Si1 and Si2 samples were determined by metallographic analysis, which are 900, 800, 770 and 750 °C, respectively.
